    import asyncio, time

    def cpu_bound():
        s = 0
        for _ in range(10 ** 8):
            s += 1
        return s

    async def main():
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        start = time.time()
        await asyncio.gather(*(loop.run_in_executor(None, cpu_bound) for _ in range(2)))
        print(round(time.time() - start) >= 2)

    await main()
